site.name: YourApp
site.tagline: A clean, modern foundation for your next product.
site.description: A reusable, production-ready starter built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

hero.title: A modern foundation for your next big idea.
hero.subtitle: Build faster and scale with confidence using a clean, production-ready architecture designed for rapid development.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to move from prototype to production with zero unnecessary complexity.

fast.title: Fast & Lightweight
fast.description: Optimized for minimal bundle size and lightning-fast render performance.

modular.title: Modular Architecture
modular.description: Easily replace components, configurations, and copy without touching core logic.

accessible.title: Accessible & Clean
accessible.description: Built with semantic HTML, high contrast, and keyboard navigation support.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Three simple steps to take your concept from idea to production deployment.

step1.title: Define requirements
step1.description: Structure your data model and user flows using our standardized patterns.

step2.title: Customize & integrate
step2.description: Configure theme tokens, replace placeholder copy, and wire up your backend APIs.

step3.title: Deploy with confidence
step3.description: Ship production builds with automated validation and responsive client interfaces.

cta.title: Ready to build your next product?
cta.subtitle: Get started today with our reusable starter template and accelerate your product roadmap.

hero.title: About Our Platform
hero.subtitle: We provide solid foundations for ambitious teams building the future of software.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Our mission is to simplify product development by providing clean, well-architected starters that eliminate boilerplate friction. We believe great products start with great developer experience and resilient architectures.

goal.title: Our Goal
goal.text: We aim to empower creators, developers, and organizations to launch high-quality digital products in days rather than months, maintaining strict standards for performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: The dedicated team behind the design and engineering of the platform.

hero.title: Features & Capabilities
hero.subtitle: A comprehensive suite of essential tools and architecture built for modern web applications.

feature1.title: Next-Gen Performance
feature1.description: Ultra-fast page loads powered by server components and optimized streaming.

feature2.title: Modular Design System
feature2.description: Easily configurable tokens, color schemes, and system typography.

feature3.title: Secure by Default
feature3.description: Built-in security best practices, typed schema checks, and protected routes.

feature4.title: Internationalization Ready
feature4.description: Seamless multi-language architecture with pluggable translation files.

feature5.title: Accessible Interfaces
feature5.description: Strict adherence to WCAG standards, ARIA attributes, and keyboard control.

feature6.title: Developer First
feature6.description: Full TypeScript support, strict type checking, and zero-configuration setups.
